name: Fudousanya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood real-estate agency: a day-off change notice, a first day helping at the shop, a guide to viewing a room, a temporary-closure notice for renovation, a new-staff training plan comparison, an essay about noticing a regular customer's reason for a bigger room, a lesson teaching a new part-timer how to photograph a property, an explainer on why in-person viewings are still needed in the era of online tours, a free moving-consultation application guide, a column on how online viewings changed the counter staff's work, a new-semester student room-hunting rule new standard, a column on the meaning of a veteran agent's skill for sensing whether a room truly fits a customer, and a one-year cooperation report with the local neighborhood association. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
